ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and $D$ is on segment $CB$, with $DA=6, DB=4$. Find the length of $CD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point C is the midpoint of the line segment $AB$,\\
$\therefore AC=\frac{1}{2}AB=5$.\\
$\therefore CD=AD-AC=6-5=\boxed{1}$.
